title: TensorPyPy: Tensor-Aware Meta-Tracing JIT Compiler
description: TensorPyPy is a fork of PyPy whose RPython meta-tracing JIT compiler provides a tensor runtime, MetaTensor. Traced chains of tensor operations in the Python program become fused GPU kernels. The code is in rpython/metatensor/, pypy/module/_metatensor/ and lib_pypy/tensorpypy/, and benchmark/ holds the MetaTensor benchmarks. Note: TensorPyPy is one part of the larger MOTION study. benchmark/motion/ (the MOTION leave transition, its rule audit and a hand-written adapter) belongs to that wider study and is not described by this record.
